en.headline: Hang Seng slides more than 450 points by late morning
en.dek: The benchmark was down 1.83 percent at 24,308 at 11am, with the tech index also weaker, as US bond yields hit multi-year highs and mainland markets stayed shut for Mid-Autumn.
body: The Hang Seng Index was 453 points lower at 24,308.05 at 11am on Friday, a drop of 1.83 percent from Thursday’s close of 24,761.13, according to Hang Seng Indexes. The session low by then was 24,275.56.

RTHK reported that the decline had widened to more than 400 points after the open, with the Hang Seng Tech Index down 107 points, or 2.48 percent, at 4,253. Property, finance and commerce sub-indices were all lower at 11am.

Overnight, US Treasury yields climbed to multi-year highs, with the 10-year yield reaching its highest level since 2007 and the 30-year yield its highest since 2004, as markets priced a greater chance of a further Federal Reserve rate increase. Oil prices also rose. Mainland stock markets were closed for the Mid-Autumn holiday.
The local market had already slipped 73 points on Thursday. Trading on Friday was expected to stay thinner than usual with the festival day and the coming National Day week.

zh.headline: 恒指午前跌逾450點 科指跌近2.5%
zh.dek: 恒生指數上午11時報24308點，跌453點或1.83%；美債息創多年高位，內地股市因中秋休市。
body: 恒生指數周五上午11時報24308.05點，較周四收市24761.13點下跌453點，跌幅1.83%，當日低位見過24275.56點，數據來自恒生指數公司。
港台報道，開市後跌幅擴大至逾400點，恒生科技指數報4253點，跌107點或2.48%。金融、地產及工商業分類指數上午11時一概向下。
隔夜美國國債收益率升至多年高位，10年期債息升至2007年以來最高，30年期債息升至2004年以來最高，市場加大對聯儲局進一步加息的預期，油價亦上升。內地股市因中秋假期休市。
港股周四已先跌73點。適逢中秋正日及國慶黃金周將至，周五成交料繼續偏淡。
